items.title: The AI Memory Boom Isn’t Over. Investors Are Just Pricing It Like It Is
items.summary: Memory stocks are crashing even as SK Hynix, Micron, and Sandisk post the best financial results in their histories. What investors are reacting to has almost nothing to do with what these companies are actually reporting.

items.title: Western Digital Sinks 16%, SanDisk Falls 11%, Micron Drops 6% as Memory Selloff Hits Storage Stocks
items.summary: Memory stocks are cratering despite blockbuster earnings, and the reason reveals something uncomfortable about how much of the AI storage boom traders had already priced in before Thursday's open.

items.title: MU, WDC, SKHY, AMD — VanEck’s Nicholas Frasse Downplays Volatility In Semiconductor Stocks, Says Chip Trade Is Still Very Strong
items.summary: During an interview with CNBC, Frasse said that the current downturn and volatility in chip and memory stocks is just a reversion to the mean more than anything else.

items.title: Sandisk, Western Digital, D-Wave, IonQ, AppLovin, Datadog, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Memory stocks falter after guidance from Sandisk and Western Digital fails to meet Wall Street’s lofty expectations.

items.title: Citi says buy the pullback in memory stocks as upcycle is still in early innings
items.summary: Investing.com -- The current AI-driven memory upcycle remains in its early stages, Citi strategists say, arguing it could ultimately outperform the industry’s last major upcycle between 2001 and 2007.

items.title: The AI Memory Shortage Just Entered Year 2. These 3 ETFs Own Every Layer From DRAM to HBM
items.summary: HBM supply remains rationed, Micron's margins have reshaped what a memory cycle can look like, and three very different ETFs are competing for the same investor dollars flowing into this trade.

items.title: Why Micron and Other Memory Stocks Are Taking Another Hit
items.summary: Shares dip after Sandisk and Western Digital fail to deliver the sort of knockout guidance investors are used to.

items.title: This Comment From Apple CEO Tim Cook Supports Buying the Dip in Micron Stock
items.summary: Tim Cook spent considerable time talking about memory prices during Apple's latest earnings call.
